what_happened: Reproduced that the FULL-regen path (generate-todo.sh -> generate-task-order.sh --print, the dominant TODO.md regeneration mechanism invoked by state-write.sh --regen-todo and most other callers) drops the Goal line unconditionally on every run, regardless of active_goal or a pre-existing hand-written TODO.md Goal line -- not only in the no-prior-line case the dispatch described. Confirmed by scratch repro: a TODO.md with an existing hand-written Goal line, regenerated via generate-todo.sh, loses the line entirely, because --print mode's GOAL_TEXT resolution is gated to MODE=="update" only and never calls read_existing_goal() or reads active_goal. Outcome #1's precedence chain must be applied to BOTH --print and --update-todo code paths, not just --update-todo, or the fix will not actually fix the review.md Section 6.7.3 call site that motivated this task (it uses --regen-todo, which goes through the --print path).
